description:
Property number 53977. Enquire through Rightmove's messaging system and we'll respond within 5 minutes, 24/7. The property is currently let at £525 per calendar month, producing an annual rental income of £6,300 and representing a gross yield of 7.00% against the £90,000 asking price.



The accommodation comprises two reception rooms, kitchen, two bedrooms and bathroom, together with an enclosed rear yard. Further benefits include gas central heating via a combination boiler and uPVC double glazing.



Homer Street is conveniently positioned for access to Hanley and Stoke-on-Trent city centre, with a wide range of shops, supermarkets and everyday amenities available locally. The wider area benefits from significant employment and education centres including Royal Stoke University Hospital, University of Staffordshire, Stoke-on-Trent College and Festival Park, helping support an established and diverse private rental market.



Transport connections are readily accessible, with Stoke-on-Trent railway station and the A500 providing connections throughout North Staffordshire and onwards towards the A50 and M6.



The existing rent also provides potential for longer-term rental growth. Wider market evidence indicates higher rents are being achieved and advertised for comparable two-bedroom accommodation across Stoke-on-Trent. Any future rental increase would, of course, be subject to the existing tenancy, applicable legislation, property condition and prevailing market conditions.

For investors seeking an income-producing freehold property at an accessible capital value, 21 Homer Street represents a straightforward opportunity to acquire an established rental asset with immediate income and potential for future rental growth.
